name: fleet-provider-config-propagation
title: Shipped provider-config fixes never reach fleet consumers
description: manifest.json installs 724 files, of which exactly two use install: if-not-exists -- .gito/config.toml and .prism/rules.json. For those, install.py --force reports preserved and writes nothing, so a correction to a broken shipped default has no delivery path. Release 0.64.21 narrowed the Gito .trellis exclusion that made sd-review dead-end on an all-excluded diff, but all eight registered fleet consumers still carry the old blanket entry and install.py cannot update them. Measured 2026-08-11, all eight .gito/config.toml files are byte-identical to the same older shipped blob, so that policy protects nothing today -- while six of the eight .prism/rules.json files match no blob the pack has ever shipped and are real customizations the same policy must keep protecting. Give these configs an upgrade path that reaches an unmodified consumer, leaves a customized one alone, and reports the ones it leaves behind.
